QUEUE dip-thrust-0: the aud timeline's weakest 8-second stretch starts at second 0 (window .71-.74); the queue lists osplit-minority-at-s3 as a refuted cause, so do not re-propose it without new evidence. Name the voice and register that differ in that stretch (fidelity.py --diagnose, attribute.py, the render pair), and say whether the same cause runs through the rest of the song. If a fix is in reach, write C:/t/thrust-aud-dip-0/fix.patch with a test that fails when the fix is short-circuited, and give its forced A/B: the file's aud rises and no other agreement column's printed value falls, or say which one falls; check it in a detached worktree under C:/t/thrust-aud-dip-0 (remove any build/audio junction with rmdir, then remove the worktree before finishing) and run the corpus byte-hash there (C:/t/melody99-land-fixes/hash.py with ROOT pointed at the worktree), naming every moved file. tasks.title: Flash_Gordon aud s1-s4 .76-.78 -> ~.89 (HEAD -> start-subtune rc=9 plus a one-frame earlier sweep): fix the opening slide sweep's onset phase
tasks.verify: Diagnosis plus scratch patch for Flash_Gordon.sid under presets.json. Start from C:/t/flash-gordon-aud-dip-0/finding.md and fix.patch (the start-subtune rc rule: rate .934 -> 1.0 of the original, but aud only .92685 -> .92738 alone, tie and travel fall, 10 files move). The remaining part: the opening portamento runs 1 call in the onset frame, 0 in the next and 3 in the third, where the original slides a full frame at onset+1 (H2G-CONVERSION-METHOD 7.uu's zero-movement frame). Find why from the player and the emitter, and write C:/t/flash-gordon-sweep-onset-phase/fix.patch (may include or supersede the rc rule) with a test that fails when the fix is short-circuited. Give its forced A/B at -t 180 --presets ../presets.json --sound with --baseline a copy of build/fidelity.json, on a scratch copy in C:/t/flash-gordon-sweep-onset-phase/sid: Flash_Gordon's aud rises and no other agreement column's printed value falls, or say which one falls; run the corpus byte-hash (C:/t/melody99-land-fixes/hash.py, ROOT at a detached worktree under C:/t/flash-gordon-sweep-onset-phase; remove any build/audio junction with rmdir, then the worktree) and give the A/B of every moved file. DONE when C:/t/flash-gordon-sweep-onset-phase/finding.md names why the onset frame does not slide, with a trace excerpt from each side; the task writes nothing under python/, presets.json or docs/. Launch fidelity.py and pytest as plain commands, never inside a ( ... & ) subshell. Never run git checkout/restore/reset/clean/stash.
